chapters.label: Berlin, live
chapters.text: Berlin, 2024, the Euro final. Spain, in red, and England are level with four minutes left. Mikel Oyarzabal passes to Cucurella, then sprints into the box. Cucurella crosses it low... Oyarzabal scores! Goal!

chapters.label: Watch his run
chapters.text: Watch his run, slowly. Guéhi is marking him. Oyarzabal sprints away from his defender and reaches the low cross first, with his right foot.

chapters.label: Behind the net
chapters.text: From behind the net: he gets there before Pickford. Spain win the Euro, two-one!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when a low cross is coming, sprint across the front of your defender. Meet it first!
